instructions.overview: Move the knee forward over a planted foot to restore controlled ankle dorsiflexion.
steps: Face a wall in a split stance with the working foot flat and the toes pointing forward.
Drive the working-side knee toward the wall over the middle toes without lifting the heel or collapsing the arch.
Return under control and repeat through the largest comfortable range.

instructions.overview: Use the band to train controlled shoulder-blade retraction without shrugging.
steps: Hold the band at shoulder height with straight arms and light initial tension.
Pull the hands apart by moving the shoulder blades back and down until the band approaches the chest.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without letting the shoulders roll forward.

instructions.overview: Brace against the incline bench and row without using torso momentum.
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and arms hanging straight.
Draw the shoulder blades back and row the dumbbells toward the hips while keeping the chest supported.
Pause at the top, then lower until the arms are long again.

instructions.overview: Sit the hips back while reaching long through the arms to open the lats and upper back.
steps: Begin on hands and knees, then walk the hands forward.
Send the hips toward the heels while keeping the arms long and palms grounded.
Breathe into the sides of the rib cage without forcing the shoulders.

instructions.overview: Train trunk control while the arms and legs move away from the body.
steps: Lie on your back with hips and knees at 90 degrees and arms reaching toward the ceiling.
Exhale to bring the ribs down and keep the lower back gently supported by the floor.
Slowly extend the prescribed opposite arm and leg without losing trunk position, then return and alternate.

instructions.overview: Use a front-held dumbbell to practice a balanced squat with the whole foot grounded.
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the chest and stand with feet around shoulder width.
Brace, then sit the hips down between the feet as the knees track over the toes.
Keep the chest tall and feet planted, then drive through the whole foot to stand.

instructions.overview: Load the hips and hamstrings with a controlled hinge while keeping the dumbbells close.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, knees softly bent, ribs stacked, and shoulders set.
Push the hips backward as the dumbbells track close to the legs; stop before the back position changes.
Drive the floor away and bring the hips forward to stand without leaning back.

instructions.overview: Open the front of the kneeling-side hip without arching the lower back.
steps: Set up half-kneeling with both knees near 90 degrees and the torso tall.
Gently tuck the pelvis, squeeze the kneeling-side glute, and shift forward slightly.
Hold a mild stretch at the front of the hip while breathing normally, then switch sides.

instructions.overview: Pull the neutral handle toward the upper chest by driving the elbows down.
steps: Sit securely under the thigh pads and take the neutral handle with arms long.
Keep the torso nearly upright and pull the elbows down toward the ribs.
Pause without shrugging, then let the arms lengthen under control.

instructions.overview: Rotate through the upper back while the bent knees keep the pelvis stable.
steps: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent, knees stacked, and both arms reaching forward.
Sweep the top arm open as the chest rotates and the eyes follow the hand.
Keep the knees together, pause within a comfortable range, then return slowly.

instructions.overview: Use an easy stationary-bike cadence to raise temperature without adding meaningful fatigue.
steps: Adjust the seat so the knee remains slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Begin with light resistance and pedal smoothly without rocking the hips.
Keep the prescribed conversational effort and increase resistance only enough to maintain control.

instructions.overview: Warm up on the rower with a leg-driven stroke and relaxed shoulders.
steps: Secure the feet, sit tall, and begin at the catch with knees bent and arms long.
Push through the legs first, then open the hips slightly and draw the handle toward the lower ribs.
Recover by extending the arms, hinging forward, and finally bending the knees.

instructions.overview: Lengthen the back of the thigh while the trunk and pelvis stay supported.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Support the lifted thigh or use a strap, then straighten the knee only as far as comfortable.
Keep the pelvis quiet and ankle relaxed; breathe, then switch sides.

instructions.overview: Rotate the upper back by reaching one arm beneath the supporting arm.
steps: Begin on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Turn one palm up and slide that arm under the other until the shoulder and side of the head approach the floor.
Keep the hips over the knees, breathe into the upper back, then return and switch sides.

instructions.overview: Stretch the back-leg calf while keeping its heel planted and foot pointed forward.
steps: Face a wall in a staggered stance and place both hands on the wall.
Keep the back knee straight, back foot forward, and heel firmly on the floor.
Lean forward until the calf stretch is mild and steady, then switch sides.

instructions.overview: Practice smooth shoulder-blade rotation and overhead motion without flaring the ribs.
steps: Stand facing the wall in a split stance with forearms on the wall and elbows near 90 degrees.
Brace gently and slide the forearms upward without shrugging or arching the lower back.
Stop at the largest controlled range, then lower slowly.
